metadataChanges.after: UTF-8 text, or null when the request value is absent.
A request value: UTF-8 text, an integer, a finite number, true, false or null.
UTF-8 text the trusted raiser supplies (a request value or a fixed name).

entry.description: The engine derived an invalid command value (non-finite, invalid text or an overflowing finite value) from its own book, equity, margin, sizing, fee, slippage or settlement state: an engine fault, never a strategy failure. stage names where it was derived.
english: The engine derived an invalid execution value.

entry.description: A recorded-outputs capacity limit was reached during the run.
english: outputs: the event queue is full
outputs: the row count is at its limit

entry.description: Recorded outputs were asked of a strategy library that records none, or the recording cannot be honoured as asked.
english: --outputs: this library records no outputs (compile the script as an indicator, or with outputs on)
--outputs: {message}
outputs: bar {bar} was recalculated after its events were cleared
outputs: recording cannot change during a run
outputs: this module declares no outputs

entry.description: The runner cannot establish an execution-platform fact its report contract requires. A pre-load backstop for an image that claimed results-digest support, raised before any strategy code loads.
english: The runner cannot establish required execution-platform identity.

entry.description: The engine could not finish producing the result after strategy execution completed: a deadline or an otherwise unclassified failure in result assembly, the results digest or serialization. An engine fault, never a strategy failure; a specific typed engine fault keeps its own code.
english: The engine could not finish producing the result after strategy execution completed.

entry.description: The report producer generated an invalid canonical result: an engine or harness fault, never a strategy failure.
english: The report producer generated an invalid canonical result.

entry.description: The report-shape request is invalid: the report shape or the curve point budget carries a value the runner refuses.
english: The report-shape request is invalid.

entry.description: The runner does not support the requested report shape. The first selected-window build supports the full shape only.
english: This runner does not support the requested report shape.

entry.description: The runner does not support the requested results digest. The first selected-window build declares no digest.
english: This runner does not support the requested results digest.

entry.description: The strategy supplied an invalid actionable value (a non-finite number, invalid text or an overflowing finite value) to a declaration, setting or command that needs a valid one.
english: The strategy supplied an invalid execution value.

entry.description: A selected-window boundary (start, end or fed start) is not aligned to the script calendar; the adjacent boundaries are carried.
english: A window boundary is not aligned to the script calendar.

entry.description: The timezone and session the selected window needs make a calendar the engine does not support; session may be null.
english: The requested window calendar is unsupported.

entry.description: The frozen primary feed's bytes differ from the SHA-256 the study recorded. The two digests are 64-character hexadecimal strings supplied by the trusted wrapper; the registry checks only that they are text.
english: The frozen primary feed bytes have changed.

entry.description: A primary-feed bar lies outside the frozen selected-window range.
english: The primary feed lies outside the frozen range.

entry.description: The supplied history exceeds a configured input cap; cap_name says which.
english: The supplied history exceeds the configured input cap.

entry.description: The legacy trade-start option was combined with selected-window mode.
english: The legacy trade-start option cannot be combined with selected-window mode.

entry.description: A requested window field differs from the study's lineage.
english: The requested window differs from the study lineage.

entry.description: The runner does not support the requested selected-window mode or a limit its build declares on it. capability names what is unsupported; timeframe carries the offending canonical timeframe and requested the offending pre-roll length where the refusal names one. Which optional argument goes with which capability is the trusted raisers' duty, not the registry's.
english: This runner does not support the requested window mode.

entry.description: The selected window holds no observations to score.
english: The study has no selected observations to score.

entry.description: The requested pre-roll is outside the range of zero to 5000 script bars.
english: Pre-roll must be between zero and 5000 script bars.

entry.description: A fill was dated before the selected window: an engine invariant failure.
english: A fill was dated before the selected window.

entry.description: A position or a resting order existed before the selected window started: an engine invariant failure.
english: The selected-window pre-start state invariant failed.

entry.description: A study that requests a selected window together with a trial pruner other than none is refused before any trial is allocated; pruner is the requested pruner's name as the caller sent it. Optimizer-only: run_json never raises it, because a backtest has no pruner.
english: The selected window cannot be combined with this trial pruner.

entry.description: The selected-window range (start, end, fed start) is invalid.
english: The selected-window range is invalid.

entry.description: The report disagrees with the trusted window counts. Raised by the caller that compares them and never emitted by run_json.
english: The report disagrees with trusted window counts.

entry.description: The selected-window request is invalid: option names the missing, malformed or conflicting field.
english: The selected-window request is invalid.
